The '''Melida Liberation Force''' was a militant group comprised of [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] residents aimed at destroying their [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] enemies and taking back control of [[Zehava]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. [[Quintama]] was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the Melida Liberation Force who participated and was killed in the [[Twenty-First Battle of Zehava]].
